query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Clean, well-separated interpretable categories (acute_sick, follow_up, well_visit) that segment visits and can be compared against duration and urgency; a strong external associational variable.

per_column.name: primary_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: Clinically meaningful body-system categories that decode reason_for_visit into groupable segments; supports comparing duration across complaint types. Slightly fine-grained (14 levels) but categories are interpretable and populated.

per_column.name: acuity_temporal_pattern
per_column.rationale: Interpretable acute/chronic/surveillance pattern categories that add a temporal-course dimension distinct from urgency, enabling meaningful segmentation against duration.

per_column.name: symptom_severity_level
per_column.rationale: Ordinal 1-5 severity scale with a well-distributed spread; an interpretable, groupable variable, though it partly overlaps conceptually with the existing urgency column.

per_column.name: clinical_mechanism_type
per_column.rationale: Interpretable etiology categories (ischemic, infectious, structural) that offer a fresh axis to compare against duration; categories are well-labeled and populated.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_intensity
per_column.rationale: Highly informative for duration: workup intensity (labs, imaging, multimodal) is a plausible mechanistic driver of visit length and forms clear, ordered segments.

per_column.name: disposition_action
per_column.rationale: Interpretable outcome categories (discharge, admit, procedure-in-visit) that segment strongly and are naturally associated with duration and urgency.

per_column.name: preventive_or_screening_focus
per_column.rationale: Interpretable categories, but heavily imbalanced (197 of ~250 are 'none_preventive'), so most levels are sparse and comparisons against duration will be weak for the minority categories.

judge.rationale: The added columns are overwhelmingly external, interpretable, groupable categorical/ordinal variables that open genuine analytical axes around visit_duration_min (workup intensity, disposition, visit type, complaint category, mechanism, acuity pattern). None are opaque scores or bare text metrics, and they extend rather than restate the focus. Minor deductions: symptom_severity_level partly overlaps with the existing urgency field, and preventive_or_screening_focus is near-constant (dominated by one value) limiting its comparative value. As a set they strongly support discovering interpretable relationships with the focus.
